results.title: The potential of Ti-6Al-7Nb, and design for manufacturing ...
results.content: # The potential of Ti-6Al-7Nb, and design for manufacturing considerations in mitigating failure of hip implants in service. Common failure modes and mechanisms for hip implants are discussed. The manuscript highlights the transformative impact of Ti-6Al-7Nb alloy and the selective laser melting technique to improve hip implants service life. To prolong hip implants’ useful life within the body system, it is crucial to comprehend human hip anatomy and biomechanics, investigate the modes and mechanisms of prosthesis failure, and identify mitigation measures pertaining to materials selection, prosthesis design, and production processes. From this review, Ti-6Al-7Nb known for its excellent corrosion resistance and superior biocompatibility is considered a promising substitute for the mostly used cytotoxic Ti-6Al-4V, functionally graded porosity design mimicking the human bone to enhance mechanical and biomedical properties, more precisely osseointegration and stress shielding, and utilization of the selective laser melting technique capable of fabricating Ti-6Al-7Nb components with intricate shapes and high geometrical accuracy can play a significant role in preventing current hip implant failures.

results.title: Experimental and numerical investigation on mechanical ...
results.content: This study examines the changes in specimen color, surface morphology, chemical bonds, and mechanical properties of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) under the influence of aging factors such as ultraviolet light, ozone, temperature, and salt spray. These environmental factors can accelerate the aging process of HDPE to varying degrees, leading to degradation of mechanical properties and even material failure6 functionalized by ultraviolet irradiation and its application. To systematically evaluate the impact of individual environmental factors on the mechanical properties of HDPE, this study employs the following methods: (1) Preparing HDPE specimens and conducting aging experiments under different accelerated weathering conditions, including UV radiation, ozone, thermal aging, and salt spray exposure, (2) Investigating the aging mechanisms of HDPE under various environmental factors through microstructural characterization, chemical composition analysis, and macroscopic mechanical property testing, and (3) Developing a numerical model based on experimental data, combining uniaxial tensile testing and numerical simulations to validate the impact mechanisms of individual environmental factors on HDPE aging behavior.
